source.coverage: whole-file structural sweep and targeted direct mechanism reads, all five original reader reports compared; supplemental mod reader notes reviewed, raw mod not re-audited

rows.heading: 1. Global state and save format (143-425)
rows.mechanism: One global registry bag saved as a pipe-delimited base64 string in one localStorage key, with no migration and a delete-the-save fallback on parse failure.
rows.rationale: Positional saves and delete-on-parse-error lose recoverable state. Many worlds and repeatability do not justify corrupting saves. Keep validated native envelopes.

rows.heading: 2. Time (953-965 and helpers 13630-13656, 13844-13880)
rows.mechanism: One master minute counter, 1 real second = 1 game minute, 30-day months, weekday and 8-phase moon derived by division; sleep runs time at 5x.
rows.save_impact: none for calendar; optional world profile for changed tuning
rows.rationale: A master calendar, sleep compression, weekday and lunar phases are mechanisms. Native equivalents exist; verify and reuse them. Do not replace the native date or add a second clock. Lunar consumer is R59/P07.

rows.heading: 3. Titles (431-880, plus unlock tables 7262-7304 and giveTitle 13760)
rows.mechanism: Long-tail joke and anti-adventure titles (9999 cat pats, a decade at home, 1M kills, Glass Bones for losing to the weakest enemy).
rows.save_impact: optional additive counters; old counters default zero
rows.rationale: A domestic life and intentionally weak/odd combat outcomes deserve long-horizon titles. Counter availability is an integration dependency on p23-life-loops, not a taste rejection. No universal 9999-pat requirement.

rows.heading: 4. Weather (883-923, 13207-13628)
rows.mechanism: Thunderstorm lightning strike: 0.09% per outdoor tick for heavy, possibly lethal damage reduced by a resistance skill.
rows.save_impact: optional opt-in hazard profile, saved RNG and next event
rows.rationale: Storm exposure/resistance is reachable as an explicitly chosen hazardous weather proposal with shelter and readable risk. Ordinary idle play stays comfortable. Lethality is a world/mode dial, not a universal ban or default.

rows.heading: 4. Weather (883-923, 13207-13628)
rows.mechanism: Winter cold arrives in gust bursts (200-1300 ticks on, 20-100 rest) rather than a constant drain.
rows.save_impact: optional gust phase/deadline under existing played clock
rows.rationale: Gust/rest cycles give a shelter/exposure rhythm distinct from constant cold. Extend the optional existing weather mode; no extra timer and no damage when mode is disabled.

rows.heading: 5. Effects (972-1423; plumbing at 10774-10794, 13864)
rows.mechanism: Item-gated auras: Sun/Moon charm day/night stat flips, Candlelight +light, Incense doubles meditation XP, Fireplace aura dries Wet and boosts cooking.
rows.save_impact: mostly derived equipment/time/fixture projections; fuel state only in P03
rows.rationale: Day/night utility, light, incense and hearth drying are real world-conditioned build choices. Prior accessories awaiting taste is not a prerequisite imposed by the director. Split portable aura P04 from home fuel P03.

rows.heading: 5. Effects (972-1423; plumbing at 10774-10794, 13864)
rows.mechanism: Fei poisoning: a pill purification DoT that pays a large EXP reward if survived, a risk/reward cultivation loop.
rows.save_impact: optional saved trial phase, dose, deadline and settled receipt
rows.rationale: Purification risk/reward fits an original optional cultivation test, but must be tied to an actual world/body/resource. Being outside Frontier is no rejection. Do not silently install Proto23 Fei in a canon world.

rows.heading: 6. Furniture (1429-1583; giveFurniture 11477, home sector 8234-8280, bed 12845-12865)

rows.rationale: Pet maturation, mood and home presence are life mechanisms. Give one original household animal recurring interaction and a useful gift/rest outcome; home rating is a derived furnishing description with a comfort consumer, not a new universal stat.

rows.heading: 1. Skill engine (Proto23)
rows.mechanism: Super-exponential uncapped XP curve with no per-gain cap; a 150k-XP book dumps straight into a skill.
rows.save_impact: optional world-specific curve profile and validated finite XP; old profile unchanged
rows.rationale: The old rejection overstates authority: native capped defaults are code, not a prohibition on other world profiles. Keep native defaults; retain high/uncapped progression and large XP grants as optional world rules, using finite arithmetic and iterative settled awards. Do not port the foreign curve verbatim.

rows.heading: 2. Item engine (Proto23)
rows.mechanism: Long tail of instant-restore foods and drinks, alcohol with a Drinking skill, EXP pills, tactical consumables (smoke bomb, monster powder).
rows.save_impact: native consumption plus optional cooldown/recipe records
rows.rationale: Timed meals need not prohibit instant medicine, alcohol, smoke escape or lures. Implement a small representative tactical pair; existing food boosts stay. Repeat use pays actual items/time, with no account-wide once limit.

rows.heading: 2. Item engine (Proto23)
rows.mechanism: Seasonal food spoilage planner: carried food rots faster in summer, slower in winter, slower in home storage.

rows.rationale: Pantry pressure fits an optional mode. Current singleton stacks cannot safely express mixing old/new batches, chest transfer, splitting and arbitrary timestamps by merely adding a field.
rows.trigger: Unpark when P08/P00 demonstrate lossless per-lot age through acquire, split/merge, chest transfer and literal import, and a proposed opt-in spoilage policy. No extra user taste approval needed to prototype.

new_finds.mechanism: Passive Famine adaptation
new_finds.save_impact: optional underfed condition and fractional XP; native food/saves unchanged
new_finds.rationale: The ledger captured energy pressure but omitted the underfed XP branch. Eligible played time alone must earn positive XP. No active-action gate, hunger death or severe mandatory efficiency curve. World/body applicability stays explicit.

new_finds.mechanism: Ambient meditation and environmental absorption
new_finds.save_impact: optional supported elemental resource/progress; no universal Ki pool
new_finds.rationale: Idle meditation and Water/Fire/Air exposure can feed separate skills/resources. Prove one original world-supported condition, fractional accrual and a real consumer; do not give every body free Ki.

new_finds.mechanism: Cross-skill training webs
new_finds.save_impact: stable milestone grant IDs; multipliers derived from learned facts
new_finds.rationale: A milestone can accelerate a related skill rather than merely grant stats/UI. Add one understandable two-skill link, no cyclic multiplicative award recursion. Coordinate reveal-chain landed milestone work.

new_finds.mechanism: Repeatable permanent growth consumables
new_finds.save_impact: optional accumulated world/body modifier, serialized once
new_finds.rationale: Life Shards, clover and potential boosters alter lasting body stats/growth, not just heal or grant XP. Reimplement one source-supported original tonic with honest effect and repeat consumption; no blanket one-per-life prohibition.

new_finds.mechanism: Tool-gated disassembly with skill/condition yields
new_finds.save_impact: actual selected-copy removal plus native outputs and skill XP
new_finds.rationale: Tool possession enables converting one owned copy into shown materials. Existing artifact removal is not general salvage. Low condition changes yield; equipped/custody-invalid copies require correct preflight.

new_finds.mechanism: Condition-aware equipment ingredient selection
new_finds.save_impact: no new field if stable E2 keys retained; consumption publishes atomically
new_finds.rationale: Crafting can select the worn copy rather than consume a pristine spare. Show exact chosen copy and allow override; preflight and receipt must agree.

new_finds.mechanism: Portable tool quality and repeat-craft pacing
new_finds.save_impact: optional saved queued recipe/progress; live tools read from native owners
new_finds.rationale: Any sharp tool, graded tailoring/alchemy tools and faster repeated crafting create expertise beyond station tiers. Keep one smallest portable-tool recipe first; a queue uses native clock and actual materials, not DOM intervals.

new_finds.mechanism: Fuel, smoke, ventilation and leaving home
new_finds.save_impact: optional hearth fuel/smoke deadline, counted native fuel
new_finds.rationale: An active hearth consumes real fuel, dries Wet and may smoke a room; ventilation/step outside changes the condition. Derived existing ventilation bonus is not a smoke loop. Opt-in safe domestic slice with extinguish and no surprise lethal upkeep.

new_finds.mechanism: Layered loot: creature, area, rank and luck
new_finds.save_impact: saved occurrence draws if encounters resume; native inventory only
new_finds.rationale: Area/rank/global rarity sources are not just creature drop tables. One optional area drop with known eligibility and a luck modifier can reuse existing native settlement; clamp valid probabilities but no global rarity ceiling.

new_finds.mechanism: Equipped kill collector with stored resource
new_finds.save_impact: optional per-copy blood/resource amount under E2 identity
new_finds.rationale: The Chalice collects from eligible kills, a distinct resource build rather than a stat amulet. Source has no demonstrated expenditure consumer. Prototype one original collection plus explicit spend/repair consumer, not an inert bar; unsubscribe by stable identity.

new_finds.mechanism: Enemy probability-gated named moves
new_finds.save_impact: saved move/intent and any cooldown only when needed
new_finds.rationale: The old level-band row bundled but did not separately map named probabilistic AI. Add one original readable status move with a counter, target-local stats and correct hook naming, not the scratch typo/shared dummy bug.
